How it Works:

The 3 C's Method

Planning an extraordinary event shouldn’t feel overwhelming—it should feel effortless and tailored from the start. That’s why Brian follows a refined, three-step approach designed to ensure that every collaboration begins with ease, mutual respect, and genuine connection.

CONNECT

Every exceptional event begins with a genuine connection. In this first step, you’ll share a few details about your vision, and Brian will take the time to understand what matters most to you. It’s a relaxed, no-pressure introduction to see if there’s a natural fit—because extraordinary experiences start with the right partnership.

CONVERSE

If it feels like the right connection, we’ll schedule a more in-depth conversation—whether in person or over video. This is where we dive deeper into your vision, style, and priorities. It’s a collaborative dialogue designed to bring clarity, spark ideas, and lay the foundation for an experience that’s thoughtfully curated around you.

CHOOSE

Once we’ve connected and had a meaningful conversation, we’ll decide together if it’s the right fit to move forward. There’s no pressure—just a mutual, confident choice rooted in trust, alignment, and a shared commitment to creating something exceptional.

Meet Your Wedding

Tour Guide

BRIAN KELM

Planning your wedding should be joyful—not stressful. But with so many moving parts and professionals who don’t always deliver, it’s easy to feel overwhelmed.

That’s why Brian Kelm founded Brian Kelm Productions—to bring integrity, clarity, and genuine care back to wedding and event experiences.

For over 30 years, Brian has helped couples across the United States create personal experiences with calm confidence and attention to every detail. He listens deeply, communicates clearly, and treats every experience like it matters—because it does.

When you work with Brian, you get more than a planner, master of ceremonies, and entertainment designer. You get a trusted guide who’s committed to making your vision a reality—and ensuring the journey is just as special as the day itself.

Personalized Wedding Planning

July 17, 2025•2 min read

STILL HAVE QUESTIONS? WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU.

How far in advance should I book your services?

We recommend reserving as early as possible, ideally 12-18 months in advance for weddings. This ensures availability and allows ample time for detailed planning. However, we can accommodate shorter timelines depending on our availability and the scope of your event.

What is included in your full service wedding planning experience?

The full service wedding experience includes initial consultation, venue selection, vendor coordination, design and styling, timeline creation, budget management, rehearsal coordination, and full day-of execution. We also provide ongoing support and communication throughout the entire planning process.

Do you work with specific professionals or can we choose our own?

Yes! We have an extensive network of trusted professional partners, but happy to work with professionals of your choosing as well. The goal is to create your dream Experience, whether that's with our recommended partners or professionals you've already selected.

What is your payment structure?

We have a three payment process. Requiring a 50% retainer to secure your date with signed service agreement. Two remaining payments made six months and three months before your event. We offer flexible payment plans for larger events and can discuss custom arrangements based on your specific needs.

Do you handle destination weddings and events?

Yes! We love destination weddings and events. We've planned experiences across the United States and internationally. Travel and accommodation costs are additional, but we handle all the logistics to ensure your destination event is seamless.

What happens if there’s an emergency on the day of the event?

We always have contingency plans in place and maintain relationships with backup professionals. Our team is experienced in handling unexpected situations quickly and discretely, ensuring your event continues smoothly without your stress or worry.

Can you work within our budget?

Absolutely! We work with a variety of budgets and pride ourselves on maximizing value. During our initial conversation, we'll discuss your budget based on priorities, value, and create a plan that delivers your vision within your financial parameters.

How involved will we be in the planning process?

You'll be as involved as you want to be! Some couples prefer to be hands-on with every decision, while others trust us to handle most details. We adapt our approach to match your preferences and comfort level throughout the planning process.
